decisive_items: arrhythmogenic right ventricular dysplasia was highly suspected
response.rationale: The presentation meets explicit ARVD diagnostic criteria with epsilon wave, T-wave inversions, QRS >110 ms, RVOT dilation, and severe RV dysfunction; cardiac sarcoidosis is only mentioned as a remaining differential due to pulmonary nodules.

rejected.why: Supported only by pulmonary nodules and its mention in the differential; no specific cardiac sarcoidosis findings such as granulomas, conduction disease, or late gadolinium enhancement are provided, while ARVD criteria are explicitly met.
